g.text: Each output drives one red through-board LED to GND when HIGH. Resistors 1.3k (maker: 1k): about 1.1 mA per LED, about 19 mA with all 16 lit.

g.desc: Each output drives one red through-board LED to GND when HIGH. Resistors 1.3k (maker: 1k): about 1.1 mA per LED, about 19 mA with all 16 lit.

g.text: A0 = A1 = A2 = GND: 7-bit I2C address 0x20. RESET tied to 3.3 V. INTA, INTB, pins 11 and 14 unconnected (as the maker's). No I2C pull-ups on the add-on.

g.desc: A0 = A1 = A2 = GND: 7-bit I2C address 0x20. RESET tied to 3.3 V. INTA, INTB, pins 11 and 14 unconnected (as the maker's). No I2C pull-ups on the add-on.

g.text: Badge power only (recorded exception to the SAO++ power switch): J1 pin 1 feeds the chip directly, as on the maker's design. There is no coin cell on this board.

g.desc: Badge power only (recorded exception to the SAO++ power switch): J1 pin 1 feeds the chip directly, as on the maker's design. There is no coin cell on this board.

g.text: Circuit: AND!XOR's DC27 'MCP23017 16 GPIO Reference Design' rev1 (2019-03-15, Apache-2.0), read from the maker's schematic picture. Layout and artwork: SAO++.
